entities.summary: David Brent Baszucki is a Canadian-born American entrepreneur, engineer, and software developer. He is best known as the co-founder and CEO of Roblox Corporation. He co-founded and was the CEO of Knowledge Revolution, which was acquired by MSC Software in December 1998. As of December 2025, Forbes estimates his net worth to be $5.6 billion USD.
